header: This is the tools panel of the search bar. It sits above the search results and shows:
- AS YOU TYPE, with no Enter: what a topic answers at once (a sum, a conversion, a date answer, a tyre size, a VIN, a BH number, a gold rate...);
- after ENTER: a calculator or reader with a page of its own, or the list of them.

I keep this file free of any topic name. Every topic (src/tools/<topic>/) says in its ui.tsx how it looks, and the list is src/tools/registry.ui.tsx; what a typed line means is decided by src/lib/tools/detect.ts from the topics' own topic.ts. All of it runs in the browser. Nothing typed here is stored or sent; the only thing downloaded is the public exchange-rate table, and only when a topic asks for it.

symbols.name: FORMS
symbols.sig: const FORMS: Array<{ id: FormKind; ui: FormUi }> = TOPIC_UIS.flatMap((t) => (t.form ? [{ id: t.id as FormKind, ui: t.form }] : []))

behaviours: an ordinary search draws nothing
a sum shows its answer large, tidied, with the Instant mark
a big sum is also said in lakh and crore
a unit conversion is laid out like Google's: the kind, the value and unit on the left, the result and unit on the right, no formula line under it
bhp to ps shows all three engine units, PS first (largest number), then bhp, then kW, laid out like Google's, with PS explained as German
a lone '100 bhp', '1 kw in ps' and 'engine power' open the same three-unit card
a temperature is converted, with no formula line
a word with several meanings shows its note (hp read as mechanical)
units of different kinds are told apart
a currency question shows the same layout, waits for the rates, and says so
a date answer shows the headline and the lines
a calculator typed but not sent says Enter opens it
both lines on the pages that take the reader's own figures and give estimates: the currency converter, the converters, PF, gratuity, leave encashment
only the line about typing where a sum or a date is exact (the calculator, dates)
only the line about estimates on the EV charging page: time and cost are estimates, and a battery size is nobody's private matter

neither line on a unit conversion, the engine-power card, a tyre size, the list of calculators, and the VIN reader (owner, 28 Nov 2026: the typing line under it is irrelevant), whether opened from the menu or by typing a VIN
the BH page says both lines ONCE, at its tax estimate (the page's own foot has none, so it is not said twice)
the currency and converter cards say that the rate table is downloaded
a tyre size typed in the bar is read part by part, as you type
'tyre size' alone offers the reader on Enter; a tyre purchase sentence is an ordinary search
the EV form lists the chargers, the times, and what the words mean
'ev charging' offers the form on Enter; 'ev policy circular' is an ordinary search
the full calculator opens as BASIC: four columns, the grey, dark and orange keys, a display of 0, and no converter in it
both calculators are sized from ONE height: the same --calc-h, key height a twelfth-part of it, basic keys as wide as tall (circles), scientific keys 1.24 times as wide as tall (the Mac's 62 : 50)
the arithmetic signs are the largest text on the keys, the digits next, the scientific words the smallest; the display number shrinks as it grows, to a floor
the display and the keys use text sized from the key height, not a fixed size
the SCIENTIFIC calculator has ten columns and every key of the Mac's: brackets, memory, powers, roots, logs, trig, hyperbolic, 2nd, EE, Rand, π, e, Rad

the calculator panel clips what is outside it and holds its grid to the right edge, so that while it widens from basic to scientific no key shows outside its edge and the new scientific keys are uncovered from the left
the calculator is a mode switch of two tabs, a history button, and the privacy notice of every card
the word 'calculator' offers the full calculator on Enter, and a typed sum offers to open it
the menu lists the ten tools and shows what to type
a BH mark typed in the bar is read part by part, as you type, and the guide sits under it

the BH guide has its sections: what it is, how the mark is built, who can have it (with the check), a new vehicle, an existing one, the papers, the tax (with the estimate), moving and selling, the doubts, and what to confirm
the BH guide opens with the Back arrow, carries the privacy and approximation notices on the tax estimate, and shows the example tax
'bh series' typed but not sent says Enter opens the guide; a BH circular sentence is an ordinary search
each form opens with its title and a Back arrow to the calculators list (not a cross: nothing is closed)
the dropdown's arrow is a rounded-square tile with a glow, never a circle; the chosen option's tick is a bold bare tick with an accent bar, never a circle: the two cannot be taken for each other
the calculators list itself keeps its cross (it leaves the search window as it is) and has no Back arrow
the loan EMI calculator of banks and societies is gone from the menu: no Loan EMI tile, and one provident fund tile that names both tabs
the PF form starts with the published rate, the VPF ceiling and the pension part, and says the rate is as of a date; its results wait for the PF page figures
the gratuity form starts with the upper limit
the leave encashment form starts with 300 days and 30
the dates form has its four tabs
the converter form offers every kind, currency, engine power and colour among them, through its own dropdown
the dropdown: a combobox with its chevron, the whole chosen label, closed at first
the dropdown's keys stay inside the list, and a long list is searched by every typed word
the dropdown is placed before it opens: below first; above only when below is too small and above is enough; else the larger side, with its list scrolling inside it, and never less than a few rows
a long number gets a smaller size so that it is seen whole, and the panel of a long text asks for more room
the only network call of the tools is the public rate table, with no body and no query
the history card's viewer makes one call, to its own document route, for a fixed document id: no body, no typed word
the tools write nothing to storage, cookies or the log
in the search bar a tool line returns before any search, name lookup or log
the panel is drawn in the search bar and the form closes when the text is edited
